desc: SureFire's Everyday Carry Series punches deep into darkness with the EDC1-DFT, a Dual Fuel, high-candela handheld flashlight that delivers impressive beam designed explicitly for long-distance illumination in a remarkably compact form factor. With a blinding, peak beam intensity of 95,000 candela using the included SF18350 rechargeable lithium-ion battery or 55,000 candela from a single 123A primary battery, the EDC1-DFT's concentrated, tightly focused beam pattern allows you to see farther into the darkness and positively identify any potential threat.
